correctness.rationale: PASS: For all nonzero real f=aH1+bH3 with standard Gaussian measure, H1=z, H3=z^3-3z, L2^2=a^2+6b^2. Independent Gaussian Wick moment expansion reproduced N(t)=15(1+24t+450t^2+5760t^3+51300t^4+287712t^5+773928t^6), and the exact rational derivative K'(t)=-360P(t)/(1+6t^2)^4. Checked the sign-pattern/Mobius transform argument showing precisely two real roots of P, one in (-.102,-.101) and one in (2.642,2.643), using independent exact Sturm real-root counting as an additional certificate. The derivative orientation, projective infinity K=53745, and values Kmin~4.6168673769 and Kmax~57613.87609658 prove globally unique projective mixed Hermite extremizers and all intermediate ratios. No conclusions asserted for multivariate/nonodd polynomial spaces.
